findings.reason: The intent faithfully preserves investigation of latency reduction while preserving retrieval quality, without inventing a method, quantitative target, or empirical result.

All material requirements are represented: the supplied baseline, latency and quality metrics, local execution, exclusions of cloud training and new datasets, and an evidence-grounded report covering comparison and limitations. The absence of supplied measurements is explicitly retained.

The baseline entity, qualitative targets, scope, exclusions, and mandatory constraints are mutually consistent. Treating missing measurements as a reporting limitation does not contradict the requested investigation.

The artifact defines an actionable research purpose and concrete report deliverable, with explicit comparison metrics and execution boundaries. It supports investigation and reporting of limitations without implying that empirical improvement has already been established.

limitations: No empirical measurements are supplied; measured latency reduction and quality preservation cannot be established from the available sources.
